text:
tj: starting rollout v2026.3.0 -> eu1 (canary 5%) now. keeping prefills enabled. will watch synths for 10m :eyes:
deploybot: deploy triggered: canary id=canary-2026-03-15-01, image=redwood/inference:v2026.3.0, targets=eu1-dedicated
deploybot: postdeploy smoke started: routes = [/generate, /embed], synth-suite=smoke-v2, timeout=4s
jamal: seeing early noise on embed synth p95, small sample but trending up. posting logs:
```
embed_synth: q=42 p95=3500ms errors=3/200 code=503
embed_worker_3: oom? saw eviction logs in container
```
sre-oncall: @tj can you pause the rollout if p95 stays >2s after warmup? prefer pin previous if it doesn’t look transient
maria: +1. also try targeted prefill for /embed on the canary nodes (kv warmup) before rollback
kevin: can we scale canary pool by +1 GPU temporarily to rule out capacity pressure? if cost ok for the window
deploybot: canary metrics (2m window): embed_p95=3.2s, embed_error_rate=1.5%, generate_p95=190ms, no routing errors
jamal: stack trace excerpt from one 503:
```
HTTP 503 from inference-proxy: downstream: model-runtime returning 500 internal; kv-cache miss thrash seen
ModelRuntime::AllocateBuffer failed: insufficient device memory
```
kevin: that leans mem pressure. scaling canary up now (+1 shard) and giving 3m for stabilization
jamal: initiating targeted kv prefill script on canary nodes:
```bash
./tools/prefill.sh --route /embed --targets canary-2026-03-15-01 --parallel 8
```
deploybot: scaling action completed: canary pool +1 shard. new capacity applied
deploybot: prefills started (task id=prefill-554)
maria: running a quick synthetic check after prefill in the canary: 
`curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route":"/embed","input":"warmup"}' https://eu1.api.redwood.inference/v1/embeddings | jq '.latency'`
jamal: quick check results: embed_p95 -> 980ms (after prefill), errors back down to 0.2%
sre-oncall: good improvement. can we let the canary run at 5% for remaining window and continue ramp if stable?
tj: pausing further rollout. hold at 5% for 30m. no rollback for now. action items: keep metrics on p95/error for /embed and /generate, keep prefill in place, observe memory alloc trends
maria: I'll open a postdeploy note in the release doc and add the prefill command + findings. also scheduling a follow-up retro if we need a hotfix
kevin: I'll schedule an autoscaler tweak PR to prefer lower bin-packing density for these models (ref: issue #4123)
deploybot: smoke-suite snapshot: canary embed_p95=0.98s, embed_error=0.1%, memory_alloc_failures=0 over 5m post-prefill
jamal: leaving a small debug capture on canary-runtime for next 20m in case we get repro
tj: thanks team. if anything degrades again, escalate to rollback immediately. otherwise we resume the ramp after hold window. :thumbsup:
